item.name: Gets a market bid available for making a second offer.

request.name: Gets a market bid available for making a second offer.

description.content:
To make a second offer, the merchant has to find a different market bid and update the order item accordingly.
In order to get a market bid for the second offer, the merchant has to provide the order item ID that they intend to change,
as well as all the details about the actual device they have received. Only the price valid at the time of order
creation will be returned, to ensure fair competition and prevent merchants from lowering the price before
making the second offer.

Known errors:
- UNAUTHENTICATED
  - when no authorization header is sent
  - when authorization header is malformed or invalid
- PERMISSION_DENIED
  - when the authorized user does not have permissions for this operation
- INVALID_ARGUMENT
  - invalid input data is provided
- NOT_FOUND
  - order item does not exist or it's not in "received" state
  - an appropriate market bid cannot be found that was active at the time of order
